name: perchlight-ask
description: A free, self-hosted ask-the-docs widget and API, plus AI-drafted support inbox replies, on Cloudflare Workers + Workers AI + Vectorize + D1 + one Durable Object. No cron trigger.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Required. A long random string (16+ characters), e.g. from `openssl rand -hex 32`. Protects the admin API (/api/*).

SESSION_SECRET.description: Required for the widget. 16+ random characters. Signs widget session tokens.

IP_SALT.description: Required for the widget. 16+ random characters. Hashes visitor IP addresses (with the UTC date) for rate limits; raw IPs are never stored.

TURNSTILE_SECRET.description: Required for the widget. The secret key of a Cloudflare Turnstile widget whose hostnames are your sites.

ASK_API_KEYS.description: Optional. JSON: name to {"hash":"<npm run hash-key output>","daily":500}, for POST /v1/ask from your own apps with X-Api-Key.

SITE_PROOF.description: Needed for sitemap sources. 16+ random characters; serve it at https://<your-host>/.well-known/perchlight-ask.txt to prove the host is yours.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. A fine-grained GitHub token with read-only Contents access on your docs repo (needed for private repos; raises the API limit for public ones).

GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Optional. The secret of a GitHub push webhook to /v1/hooks/github, which starts a re-ingest early.

RESEND_API_KEY.description: Optional, off by default. Only used when NOTIFY_PROVIDER=resend or INBOX_SEND=resend.
